service.name: Arcadion Raids (Savage)
service.longDescription: Fighters from across the star step into the Arcadion’s ring, where glory is won before a roaring crowd. From the Light-heavyweight ladder to the Heavyweight throne, only the unbroken earn the right to call themselves Grand Champion. Will you answer the call?

rewards.title: Savage Gear
rewards.text: Dark Horse, Babyface & Grand Champion gear ranging from ilvl 730 to 795 depending on the tier.

rewards.title: Black Cat Card, Illustrated Tokens & Facewear
rewards.text: Exclusive collectibles, exchange tokens and glamour from the savage fights.

rewards.title: Achievement: “Cruising at the Savage Apex I” & More
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon defeating Dawntrail Savage Tier.

accordion.title: Requirements
items: Normal Mode Completion / Fight Unlocked (available as additional services)
